source_note: 以2013年近正面照片和转角斗栱细节为主；2009年旧照辅助区分院前独立经幢与大殿本体。首版把经幢误作柱子，已弃用并重绘。三开间，两窗夹门，四组柱头斗栱，正脊带中央宝瓶。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, no broad grey shading, no crosshatching, no pencil grain, no texture, no gradient. No color, no gold, no black background. The white will become transparent and the ink uniformly gold in the website.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Subject: CHUNHUA TEMPLE 淳化寺 main hall in Pingshun, a SMALL THREE-BAY single-storey Jin hall. Image 2 is the real front facade; two stone scripture pillars stand several metres in the FOREGROUND and happen to overlap the building. THOSE CYLINDRICAL STONE OBJECTS ARE NOT ARCHITECTURAL COLUMNS AND MUST BE COMPLETELY REMOVED. The building corners behind them are simple vertical RECTANGULAR MASONRY WALL corners, as shown in detail Image 3. Image 4 is the same hall before repair seen from another side and clarifies that the detached scripture pillars are separate; use it only to understand the building volume, not the facade openings. Draw ONLY the main hall from Image 2, facing straight-on, with exactly 3 bays: left rectangular barred window, central rectangular closed double door, right rectangular barred window, all set in an almost blank flat masonry wall with narrow rectangular pilasters. NO FREESTANDING PILLARS anywhere; no large circular bases, no cylindrical supports, no stone steles. Single hip-and-gable roof, modest ridge ornaments at the ends and a small central ridge finial, deep sweeping eaves with lifted tips; simple minimal dougong supported above the rectangular facade wall. No extra intermediate ornate bracket sets, no second tier or porch. Same sparse delicate contour style as Image 1. Blank white walls, NO individual brick courses. Roof mostly blank white with only 8-12 widely spaced contour strokes. Low rectangular stone base and 3 modest central stairs. Remove modern wires, road works, material piles, people, landscape, adjacent houses and all writing. Landscape 1536×1024, complete roof and base with 10% white margin, building occupying about 80% width. Elegant thin contours, restrained internal details, no texture and no filling.

historical_sources.title: 山西平顺阳高村淳化寺大殿
historical_sources.note: 三间六椽九脊顶、普拍枋、无补间、柱头四铺作单（假）昂；整根六椽栿通搭前后檐、蜀柱剳牵代四椽栿；前后开门、后檐小抱厦后加；无题记按结构断金；经幢开宝三年；大定九年李晏碑及龙门寺后檐柱题记；李晏《金史》有传、礼部尚书

historical_sources.note: 维基百科，二手来源：北齐天保创建、原称龙门禅院、龙门寺下院、开宝重建、淳化二年改名、雍正嘉庆民国维修；三间六椽单檐歇山、出檐宽大；经幢开宝三年分刻《金刚经》《尊胜陀罗尼经》；大定己丑（1169）李晏诗碑；曾被圈入中学院内
